question: The rhythmic rise and fall of ocean water twice in a day is called a ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**tide**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tide**

 
 
• Tides are** the rise and fall of sea levels caused by the combined effects of the gravitational forces exerted by the Moon and the Sun**, and the rotation of the Earth. 
 
• Tide tables can be used for any given locale to find the predicted times and amplitude
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Tides are **very long-period waves that move through the ocean in response to the forces exerted by the moon and sun**. 
 
• Tides originate in the ocean and progress toward the coastlines where they appear as the regular rise and fall of the sea surface

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a622c77e2e4a1b5eba844b88ec39fdc86d499f6c2c39870abc274737e01c5541.png]
